lines.text: Lush with musical themes. Gorgeously written. Absolutely unforgettable. Like a musical composition of its own, Partita intimately explores one woman’s passion for musical excellence against the backdrop of a rural upbringing and complicated family ties. With Partita, Kingsolver delivers a literary masterpiece.
